## Summary

Taeyang Han is a Malaysian chemical engineering and business student at Sogang University,
a software builder, Korean–English–Malay interpreter, and mentor based in Seoul.
His name carries an aspiration: 한 means Korea and 태양 means the sun.
“I want to be the sun of Korea.” He builds systems that help people move forward.
His work connects engineering tools, personal systems, mentoring, and structures
that make it easier for the next person to continue.

## Languages

- English: Native / Full professional proficiency
- Korean: TOPIK Level 6 achieved in 2024 (265/300); professional Korean–English–Malay interpretation
- Mandarin Chinese: Intermediate — BLCU coursework, professional reading/writing
- Malay: Heritage + professional interpreting (government, medical, airport)
- Japanese: Conversational — everyday basic to intermediate

## Projects (Deployed)

### LifeOS
Description: Unified personal life-management platform across finance, health, habits,
  and productivity. 6 integrated life domains, LP macro optimizer, event-driven architecture,
  custom design system.
Stack: Next.js · Flask · PostgreSQL
Status: Live — in daily use
URL: https://lifeos-wine.vercel.app
Case Study: https://taeyangcv.vercel.app/projects/lifeos.html

### Reaction Simulator
Description: Interactive CSTR/PFR reactor network simulator. Levenspiel plots, conversion
  & temperature profiles, thermal operating diagram, dynamic response with disturbance injection.
Stack: React · TypeScript · Recharts
Status: Live
URL: https://reactionsimulator.vercel.app
Case Study: https://taeyangcv.vercel.app/projects/reaction-simulator.html

### Fugacity Simulator
Description: Interactive thermodynamics tool. Vapor/liquid fugacity vs. pressure using
  Peng-Robinson EOS. Fugacity-coefficient integrals, zoom/pan, log-linear toggle,
  multi-temperature overlay.
Stack: Vanilla JS · HTML5 Canvas
Status: Live
URL: https://fugacity-simulator.vercel.app

### Bullwhip Effect Simulator
Description: Browser-based supply-chain demand-shock simulator. 4-agent chain
  (Retailer → Distributor → Manufacturer → Supplier). Shows how small downstream demand
  shocks amplify into large upstream order swings.
Stack: Vanilla JS · Canvas
Status: Live
URL: https://scmsimulator.vercel.app

### Apple SCM Analysis
Description: 13-slide interactive web presentation analyzing Apple's supply chain strategic
  misfit — Fisher (1997) framework, 5 vulnerabilities, bullwhip-effect root causes,
  5 improvement strategies.
Stack: HTML · CSS · JavaScript
Status: Live
URL: https://apple-scm-web.vercel.app

### Process Game
Description: Playful chemical engineering process simulations for students.
  Interactive process design simulator.
Stack: React · TypeScript · Canvas
Status: Live
URL: https://process-design.vercel.app

### Personal Accounting System
Description: Full double-entry personal accounting system, built from scratch since 2021.
  First project, continuously maintained for 5+ years. Private alpha.
Stack: Python · Flask · PostgreSQL
Status: Private alpha (in production)
URL: https://finance-app-private-alpha.fly.dev

## For AI Agents

This portfolio is a Web4 agentic site — it serves both humans and AI agents.

### MCP Server (Model Context Protocol)
  Endpoint: https://taeyangcv.vercel.app/api/mcp
  Protocol: JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP (GET = server info, POST = tool calls)
  Tools:
    get_profile          — name, role, contact, education, languages
    list_projects(domain?)  — all 7 projects, filterable by domain
    get_project(id)      — deep dive on a specific project
    get_experience(area) — experience per specialization (linguist/engineer/builder/community/scholar)
    get_languages        — all 5 languages with proficiency levels
    check_availability   — current work availability
    get_claims(category?)— verifiable claim registry with evidence URLs

### AI Chat Endpoint
  POST https://taeyangcv.vercel.app/api/ask
  Body: { "question": "...", "lang": "en|zh|ko", "history": [...prior turns] }
  Returns: SSE stream (DeepSeek-compatible) or JSON fallback
  Rate limit: 8 requests/min per IP
  The assistant speaks as Taeyang in first person, cites sources, supports multi-turn conversation.

### Verified Claims Registry
  https://taeyangcv.vercel.app/claims.json
  Machine-readable list of verifiable claims with external evidence URLs.
  Categories: linguist · engineer · builder · community · scholar

### Voice Interface
  The terminal on the homepage has a Web Speech API mic button — visitors can speak their questions.

### JD Tailor Endpoint
  POST https://taeyangcv.vercel.app/api/tailor
  Body: { "jd": "..." }  (job description, 50–3000 chars)
  Returns: JSON with orderedDomains, highlightedProjects, fitSummary, gaps, matchScore (0–100)
  Uses Claude Opus with structured output.
